sentences: Earn {£80,000|eighty thousand pounds} this tax year, and all your Child Benefit goes back.
Two kids? That's over {£2,300|two thousand, three hundred pounds} a year.
Next door, two parents earn {£100,000|a hundred thousand pounds} together… and keep it all.
The charge looks at each parent, not the household.
It starts at {£60,000|sixty thousand pounds}, and two on half each never cross it.
Some parents stop claiming to dodge it.
Then a parent at home loses credits towards their State Pension.
So before you stop claiming, remember:
